_market: Baghdad, Iraqi dinar, Arabic, phone first. Everything a customer reads is Arabic and the page is dir=rtl. The Latin fields below are internal labels, except a game's brand name, which is normal on a Baghdad shelf.

The EUR prices in that document are superseded by the Baghdad buy and are deliberately NOT copied here.

games.sentence_en: Start it with one person and a third walks over. This is how the night begins.
Nobody loses, so nobody leaves. Strangers go quiet, then shout together.
The calm table. For the two people who will not play a shouting game.
A proper board game that ends before anyone is bored. The parent's yes.
The best-looking box in the room. People pick it up before they know the rules.
Nine cards of rules and a twenty-minute argument. The cheapest "again".
One sentence of rules: lie about the bug. Everyone can bluff.
The only box here that seats ten. When the table grows, this is the answer.
Exactly two players. For the couple who came together and want to stay a pair.
The famous game, finished before the coffee is cold. It sells the big box later.
